Container.Name: VPN Exit Bench
Container.Overview: Unraid-native WebUI for benchmarking WireGuard and OpenVPN exits with raw-speed and EU peer-connectivity tests. Keep the WebUI on a trusted LAN; Docker Socket Proxy mode is recommended.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-09-02
Public-release security hardening: optional authentication, CSRF protection, runtime config validation and Docker Socket Proxy support.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: VPN Exit Bench WebUI. Do not expose this port directly to the public internet.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database and VPN config storage

Config.Name: WebUI Username
Config.Description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth username. Set together with WebUI Password.

Config.Name: WebUI Password
Config.Description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth password. Strongly recommended when other LAN clients can reach the WebUI.

Config.Name: Docker Host (recommended proxy mode)
Config.Description: Leave empty for the local Docker socket. Recommended secure mode: tcp://vpn-exit-bench-socket-proxy:2375 on a private user-defined Docker network.

Config.Name: Docker Socket (legacy/direct mode)
Config.Description: Direct Docker daemon access. Remove this mapping when DOCKER_HOST points to a Docker Socket Proxy.

Config.Name: Worker Image
Config.Description: Docker image used for short-lived VPN benchmark workers

Config.Name: Host VPN Config Directory
Config.Description: Fallback host path containing provider folders and VPN config files
